package.name: sam_manager_msgs
package.description: ROS 2 message and service definitions for sam_manager — a promptable segmentation service that wraps SAM-family backends (SegGPT first, pluggable for VRP-SAM / PerSAM-F / SAM 2). Contract: image + reference (image + mask) -> mask. Does not classify, does not handle depth, does not compute pixel-to-mm conversion (all are application-layer responsibilities).
